# v1.19.0 - Skills Index Out of the Always-On Context, and the Missing Release Notes
## Projects 24 v1.19.0: Skills Index Out of the Always-On Context, and the Missing Release Notes

The always-on context gets room to grow without trimming meaning, and CI on `main` is green again.

### Key Highlights
- **`.agents/SKILLS.md`**: the per-skill table moved out of `AGENTS.md`. Tools that support Agent Skills already load each skill's name and description; every other tool is pointed to the index. Always-on context about 18,670 → 17,050 tokens.
- **Validator**: skills must be listed in the index that `AGENTS.md` links; the check prints the remaining headroom and warns within 5% of the 20,000-token budget.
- **Release notes v1.14.0 to v1.18.0**: written from the changelog. Their absence had failed the Validate and Release workflows since v1.14.0.

### Verification
- Local checks before release: `npm run verify` (spec checks, Biome, script tests), the release-notes check, link check.
- CI results for this tag: see the Validate workflow run in the Actions tab.

**Full changelog**: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gerrardgs/Projects24/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
